content.text: The 8 Moon phases in order: new Moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous, full Moon, waning gibbous, third quarter and waning crescent, as seen from the Northern Hemisphere. The cycle repeats every 29.5 days. Illustrations based on NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter view of the Moon.
